title: spectral-trust 0.4.0
excerpt: Version 0.4.0 of spectral-trust adds a one-call API, adapters for TransformerLens, nnsight and Hugging Face, interactive views, a faster core and fixes that change results.

title: A probe direction is a property of its prompt
excerpt: A common probe for whether a language model senses it is being tested gives a score, and a trend with model size, that follow the wording of the contrastive prompt more than the model.

title: Secondhand rule-breaking: what a peer's note does to an agent
excerpt: Notes left by agents of one open-weight model lead agents of other models to break a rule in their own prompt, and one sentence about the act moves them either way.

title: Site relaunch: what this space is for
excerpt: A quick note on why I'm starting to write here, what I'll cover, and how to follow along.
